content:
Together with @Johan Commelin, we are starting the Informal Formalization Seminar at Utrecht University and VU Amsterdam. It is a seminar on formalization of mathematics and adjacent subjects. As the name suggests, the seminar aims to be a relaxed environment, with plenty of room for questions and discussions. Anybody interested is very welcome to attend (onsite, we do not intend to stream the event).

The first installment of the seminar is on the 19th of January 2024 at Utrecht University. For more information, including details of the programme, see:
https://jcommelin.github.io/informal-formalization-seminar
:bell: Hello Dutchies! This is a reminder that in two days is the first installment of the Informal Formalization Seminar. See https://jcommelin.github.io/informal-formalization-seminar

The next installment of IFS will take place on Fri 8 March, at the VU Amsterdam, with talks by Christian Merten, Paige North and Floris van Doorn.

For details, see https://jcommelin.github.io/informal-formalization-seminar

The next installment of IFS will take place on Fri 18 October, at Utrecht University, with talks by Jiang Jiedong and Jim Portegies.

For details, see https://jcommelin.github.io/informal-formalization-seminar
"Jiang Jiedong (Peking University + Utrecht University), The Formalization of Fontaine-Wintenberger Theorem in Lean 4" :eyes:

The next installment of IFS will take place 24 Jan 2025, at VU Amsterdam, with talks by María Inés de Frutos Fernández and Andrew Yang.

For details, see https://jcommelin.github.io/informal-formalization-seminar

Please note that tomorrow's Informal Formalization Seminar at VU Amsterdam will start/end 15 minutes earlier than announced before.
For more details, including abstracts, see https://jcommelin.github.io/informal-formalization-seminar

The next installment of IFS will take place 25 April 2025, at Utrecht University, with talks by Joël Riou and Pim Otte.

For details, see https://jcommelin.github.io/informal-formalization-seminar

The next edition of the Dutch Informal Formalization Seminar will take place on Friday October 31 :pumpkin: at the University of Amsterdam. The speakers are @Dhyan Aranha, @Calle Sönne and @Xavier Généreux

More details at the IFS website.

The next edition of the Dutch Informal Formalization Seminar will take place on Friday December 12 at the Eindhoven University of Technology. The speakers are Jelle Piepenbrock, @Rob Schellingerhout and Dick Arends.

More details can be found at the IFS website.

The next installment of IFS will take place on Fri 19 June, at VU Amsterdam, with talks by Marijn Heule, Jasmin Blanchette, and Alain Chavarri Villarello.

For details, see https://jcommelin.github.io/informal-formalization-seminar
